title: Critical Biometric Security & Anti-Spoofing Update
releaseNotes: Enhanced Anti-Spoofing Engine: Blocks OLED smartphone screens (iPhone 15 Pro Max) and 2D replay attacks via bilateral eye blink verification, screen bezel detection, and rigid tremor suppression.
Hardened Biometric Thresholds: High-precision SFace cosine match floor eliminates false accepts from friends, relatives, or similar faces.
Zero Ghost Unlocks: Lock screen match cache immediately flushes on session arrival and camera idle, preventing auto-unlocks when no one is present.
Smart PIN & Password Guidance: Seamless Windows Hello PIN and Microsoft Account password guidance.
